name: Materials Flatband Database / Topological Quantum Chemistry
redistribution: Publish only source URLs, ICSD identifiers, citations, and project-authored expert labels unless the database grants written redistribution permission; never redistribute site POSCAR/CIF/band/DOS assets by default.
access: Public website with no documented stable API, version contract, or rate limit.
source_version: 2022 Nature catalogue plus retrieval timestamp; no official database release identifier found
local_cache_policy: No bulk copy; cache only bounded factual identifiers and hashes for private audit.
scientific_ceiling: Database flatness fields are case seeds, not benchmark gold; every relevance/mechanism judgment is independently expert annotated.
rationale: The paper reports 55,206 ICSD materials, 2,379 curated high-quality entries, and 345 candidates, but public availability and citation instructions do not establish an open redistribution license; the structures derive from ICSD.

name: Inorganic Crystal Structure Database
redistribution: Do not download, index, text-mine, or redistribute ICSD records, coordinates, CIF, or POSCAR in the public benchmark.
access: Licensed subscription/API agreement only.
source_version: Not applicable to public v0 corpus
local_cache_policy: No ICSD-derived structure cache in the project.
scientific_ceiling: May appear only as an external provenance pointer for a separately sourced case.
rationale: Official terms restrict automated extraction and external redistribution; a TQC export control does not supersede the upstream ICSD license.

name: Crystal Net Catalog of Model Flat Band Materials
redistribution: Supplementary data may be redistributed with CC BY 4.0 attribution and change notice; code is MIT. Preserve Materials Project provenance for material identifiers.
access: Open article supplementary spreadsheet and public GitHub repository.
source_version: article 2024-02-20; Git commit 399fb96897c915b0c9eec0c34e207b2ed0763e0d
local_cache_policy: Pin supplementary-data hash and repository commit; no unversioned refresh.
scientific_ceiling: A uniform-hopping flat-band motif is a mechanism seed and hard negative/ambiguous stratum, not evidence that the real electronic structure is flat.
rationale: The open study screened 139,367 Materials Project materials and reported 63,076 motif hits and at least 31,635 unique nets; the authors explicitly require chemical and electronic-structure filtering.

name: NIST JARVIS-DFT and JARVIS-WTB
redistribution: Use only exact Figshare records and versions carrying CC BY 4.0; preserve attribution, file identity, and transformations. Third-party aliases exposed by jarvis-tools are not covered.
access: Anonymous Figshare read/download; use bounded files or record subsets.
source_version: 3D v10 and 2D v8 dated 2022-12-12; WTB record posted 2020-06-13
local_cache_policy: Pin Figshare article ID, version, filename, checksum, and license; do not trust a mutable jarvis-tools alias alone.
scientific_ceiling: Computed DFT/WTB records can seed or independently characterize cases but do not establish experimental flatness or expert usefulness.
rationale: Official NIST pages expose structures and electronic properties, and the exact cited Figshare records have explicit CC BY 4.0 licenses.

name: Computational 2D Materials Database / CMR
redistribution: Redistribute raw or adapted C2DB data only in a separately attributed CC BY-SA 4.0 data package with change notes; do not silently combine it into a differently licensed monolithic corpus.
access: Anonymous official ASE database and archive downloads; prefer the official snapshot over the currently unhealthy CMR OPTIMADE endpoint.
source_version: data version 2024-05-01 with 16,789 entries
local_cache_policy: Pin snapshot name/date/hash; cache only selected case records for v0.
scientific_ceiling: Homogeneous computations support 2D strata and counterexamples, not experimental truth or expert relevance labels.
rationale: CMR explicitly licenses its databases under CC BY-SA 4.0; C2DB offers rich reproducible electronic fields but requires share-alike isolation.

name: Materials Project core data

licenses.scope: Materials Project core records with compatible origin

redistribution: Include only MP-core records whose origins/provenance pass the license filter; attribute MP and record transformations. Exclude GNoME BY-NC and unverified MPContribs content by default.
access: API key for API; anonymous AWS Open Data snapshots remain subject to MP terms; initial API limit documented as 25 requests per second.
source_version: Record get_database_version() and build collection for every extraction
local_cache_policy: Use fields/has_props filtering and a frozen local subset; no full database download for v0.
scientific_ceiling: Computed values and motif matches are case features, not experimental or expert judgments.
rationale: Core MP data is CC BY 4.0 and useful for cross-linking Crystal Net cases, but recent database versions mix differently licensed contributed origins that require record-level filtering.

name: Crystallography Open Database
redistribution: Structures and database records may be redistributed; retain original structure citation, COD identifier, revision, and quality/retraction flags as scientific attribution.
access: Anonymous CIF search/read and versioned archive access; use bounded queries or an official snapshot.
source_version: Per-record COD SVN revision plus snapshot date
local_cache_policy: Pin COD ID, revision, CIF SHA-256, original citation, and issue state.
scientific_ceiling: Open crystal structure is an input; it carries no flat-band or mechanism truth without independent evidence.
rationale: COD explicitly dedicates the data and database to CC0 and is the preferred replacement structure source when TQC points to restricted ICSD structures.

name: NOMAD public archive

licenses.scope: each audited public upload or entry

redistribution: Include only published, non-embargoed records with an explicit compatible license and audited upstream provenance; never redistribute restricted raw auxiliary files such as POTCAR.
access: Anonymous public entry read; private/embargoed access requires token. Deployment limits may be about 30 requests per second and 10 concurrent requests; obey live 503/rate signals.
source_version: Pin entry_id, upload_id, publication timestamp, parser/schema/code version
local_cache_policy: Request only required metadata/archive fields and cache exact response hashes; no whole-upload downloads.
scientific_ceiling: A public calculation record supplies evidence candidates, not a benchmark gold label.
rationale: NOMAD published entries are designed for CC BY 4.0 release, but record-level license, embargo, parser, and raw-file provenance must be verified before public reuse.

name: Materials Cloud Archive and databases
redistribution: Include only record files with explicit CC0, CC BY, or another preregistered compatible license; exclude BY-NC, unknown, and upstream-restricted records. Archive metadata itself is CC BY-SA 4.0.
access: Anonymous public record read; deposit/version management requires an account.
source_version: Pin specific-version DOI, record version, file MD5, and license rather than concept DOI alone
local_cache_policy: Cache only individually approved files and their license/provenance manifest.
scientific_ceiling: Per-record calculations can seed cases only; aggregation does not confer a uniform scientific or legal status.
rationale: Materials Cloud intentionally permits record-specific SPDX licenses and can contain data ultimately derived from restricted databases, so a blanket inclusion is unsafe.

name: AFLOW repository and AFLUX API
redistribution: Do not package AFLOW JSON, CIF, or numeric fields in the default public benchmark; retain only AUID/AURL pointers, query, citation, and project-authored labels unless written permission is obtained.
access: Anonymous AFLUX REST access with no stable official request-per-second promise found.
source_version: Dynamic API retrieval timestamp and AUID/AURL only
local_cache_policy: No public data cache; local sensitivity analysis only after explicit research-license review.
scientific_ceiling: Pointer-only source in v0.
rationale: The official data terms limit free use to scientific, academic, and non-commercial purposes and do not provide an unrestricted redistribution license; ICSD-origin records add another restriction.

name: 2DMatPedia
redistribution: Redistribute with CC BY 4.0 attribution and transformation notes; retain MP-derived provenance for top-down structures. Article-associated metadata is CC0.
access: Public JSON/Figshare/MPContribs history and an OPTIMADE provider; pin the actual accessed endpoint and record count.
source_version: Scientific Data 2019 release; OPTIMADE dashboard checked 2026-05-09 with 6,351 structures
local_cache_policy: Use a frozen subset and hash; do not rely on an unversioned domain download.
scientific_ceiling: 2D material properties seed OOD cases; they do not supply expert flat-band labels.
rationale: The official data descriptor provides an open download and CC BY 4.0 reuse terms, making it a reproducible 2D structural substrate for independent flat-band annotations.

name: ELF encoded flat-band 2D materials
redistribution: Pin and attribute the exact Hugging Face dataset revision; retain 2DMatPedia provenance and do not present clustering/fingerprint outputs as accepted physical labels.
access: Public 4.61 MB Hugging Face dataset; no bulk model or image corpus required for v0.
source_version: Hugging Face revision 42838eb3c35f28c0f51039b6537de3578152467d
local_cache_policy: Download only the small tabular files after preregistration and record file hashes.
scientific_ceiling: Unsupervised clusters and the underlying 2,127 preselected materials are candidate/dedup seeds, not ground truth or expert relevance grades.
rationale: The open article links the dataset and the pinned dataset card declares MIT; duplicate and fingerprint information is useful for diversity/error strata.

name: Struct2Flat

licenses.scope: repository code and released processed labels

redistribution: Pin and attribute the repository commit; preserve 2DMatPedia/C2DB upstream licenses for training/candidate records and publish algorithmic scores only as source features.
access: Public GitHub data/code repository.
source_version: Git commit 2ed5f320ee2428e02ce8f054ad1c2bd30ec5d1a4
local_cache_policy: After preregistration, cache only selected tabular records and hashes, not model weights by default.
scientific_ceiling: A preprint's algorithmic flatness score and model predictions are candidate seeds, not independent gold labels; DFT-validated examples must still be expert adjudicated.
rationale: The repository is MIT and includes the training/candidate dataset, providing a recent 2D candidate pool and an alternative operational flatness definition for robustness analysis.

name: Crossref REST metadata
redistribution: Public benchmark includes DOI, title, year, source, queries, factual metadata, and hashes. Abstract text remains local because copyright may belong to author/publisher.
access: REST without signup; use polite mailto/User-Agent, response-header limits, one connection, caching, and 429 backoff. v0 remains at most eight physical requests.
source_version: Dynamic REST v1 response pinned by retrieval time and raw SHA-256
local_cache_policy: Encrypted/private bounded raw cache; public normalized facts and hashes only; no annual 208 GB snapshot.
scientific_ceiling: B0 retrieval source; metadata relevance is not scientific correctness, and abstract presence is not a reuse license.
rationale: Crossref is the existing bounded baseline and openly exposes broad DOI metadata; its sparse abstracts/subjects and deposited-reference coverage motivate matched-budget multi-source ablations.

name: OpenAlex
redistribution: Standardized records and derived fields may be public; cite OpenAlex and preserve retrieval/update timestamps despite CC0.
access: Freemium API: free key has a daily credit budget; filtered official CLI/snapshot also available. Use selected fields/DOI batches, not the 330 GB compressed snapshot or content-download product.
source_version: Quarterly public snapshot cadence or dynamic API with work updated_date and acquisition timestamp
local_cache_policy: Cache only 120-case query/DOI subsets and exact normalized response hashes.
scientific_ceiling: Primary E2 graph/semantic metadata source; topics, keywords, and citation links are database annotations, not expert mechanism judgments.
rationale: The complete metadata dataset is CC0 and covers topics, keywords, references, citations, and OA fields missing or sparse in Crossref, at tractable filtered-API cost.

name: OpenAIRE Research Graph
redistribution: Public records require OpenAIRE attribution and release/source provenance; parts separately sourced as CC0 may retain that status only when proven.
access: Unauthenticated API about 60 requests/hour or authenticated about 7,200/hour; use cursor and selected records, not multi-gigabyte archives.
source_version: Graph v11.3.0 dated 2026-08-04 for API; stable bulk v11.0.1 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20428976 dated 2026-05-12
local_cache_policy: Cache bounded responses with release/version and raw hash; deduplicate Crossref/DataCite/PubMed aggregates by stable identifier.
scientific_ceiling: E2-B graph/OA increment; aggregation must not be counted as independent evidence and its FoS/SDG classifications are not expert mechanism labels.
rationale: The graph is openly reusable under CC BY and provides provenance-rich relationships and access/license fields complementary to OpenAlex.

name: arXiv metadata
redistribution: Publish arXiv ID, descriptive metadata, query, categories, and hashes. Do not mirror e-print/PDF/source unless the individual work license permits it.
access: Atom API/OAI-PMH/RSS; one request per three seconds and one connection; OAI metadata supports incremental harvesting.
source_version: Nightly metadata plus record version history/retrieval timestamp
local_cache_policy: Bounded metadata-only cache for cond-mat strata; exclude the multi-terabyte requester-pays full-text bulk product.
scientific_ceiling: High-recall preprint source; preprint status and abstract claims require expert review and cannot supply validated material properties.
rationale: arXiv contributes recent cond-mat work often absent or delayed in DOI indexes, while its CC0 metadata supports a public manifest if e-print rights remain separate.

name: CORE
redistribution: Do not publish raw API/dataset abstracts or full text until CORE provides project-specific written permission and record-level rights are enforced; factual IDs may be retained.
access: API key/limits and dataset access documentation currently differ across official pages; conservative low-rate use only after access review.
source_version: Pin API/dataset release and written permission if activated
local_cache_policy: No v0 cache; later private sensitivity analysis only.
scientific_ceiling: Not part of the locked primary benchmark unless the preregistered license Gate is satisfied before corpus freeze.
rationale: CORE does not own all underlying content rights, its current terms are mixed/evolving, and old ODC-By dump labels do not establish current public redistribution permission.

name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph
redistribution: Do not put S2 response data, abstracts, graph records, or derived record packages in the public benchmark. Reconsider only with an explicit expanded written license.
access: API/dataset releases exist, but access does not remove internal-use and no-share restrictions.
source_version: Not activated for v0
local_cache_policy: No default cache; any separately approved private sensitivity analysis must be isolated and non-exporting.
scientific_ceiling: Excluded from the primary/public evaluation to avoid a license-confounded comparison.
rationale: The official API license limits use to internal legitimate non-commercial research/education and prohibits sharing, transfer, or sublicensing response data to third parties.

name: Europe PMC

licenses.scope: abstract and full-text content per work

redistribution: Publish only factual identifiers and project-authored annotations by default; abstract/full-text reuse follows each work's author/publisher/OA license.
access: Public REST API with cursor/pageSize; use conservative low concurrency and retry because no fixed public rate was found.
source_version: REST v6.9 retrieval timestamp or pinned bulk release if later activated
local_cache_policy: No v0 cache outside a preregistered biology-interface stratum.
scientific_ceiling: Only relevant to a separately declared biomaterials, biosensing, or nanomedicine cross-domain stratum; not the core flat-band corpus.
rationale: The service is free and rich in biomedical entities but lacks a uniform open license over all response content and would add domain imbalance to the main physics benchmark.
